title: Steph Curry, Sabrina Ionescu will reportedly not hold 3-point contest rematch during NBA All-Star weekend
text:
According to the reports, one of the most prominent aspects of the All-Star weekend of the NBA last season will not return for this year’s festivities.
According to Atlético Steph Curry of the Golden State Warriors and the New York Liberty Sabrina Ionescu star will not have a 3 -point shooting rematch when the best of the NBA meets in San Francisco this weekend. None of the players were interested in playing the same event again. Instead, they wanted to include another male and female player: Klay Thompson and Caitlin Clark.
Clark, however, refused to participate and issued a statement in January through his agency saying that “he wants his first 3-point contest to be in WNBA ALL-STAR in Indianapolis this summer.”
Even after a last effort of the NBA this week to convince Curry and Ionescu that they maintain revenge 1 to 1, an agreement could not be reached.
Curry and Ionescu faced Indianapolis last year, with both players shooting from the 3 -point line of the NBA of 23 feet, 9 inches. Curry won by a score of 29-26.
Both players said before the event last year that who won, the loser would like a rematch. Ionscu, which will attend this weekend, said Last week to USA Today He would welcome a rematch if he was asked to participate.
“If this year or in the future happens, we both have a lot of basketball, so we will definitely arrive at some point.” Ionscu said . “It’s a kind of TB in that. But I’m excited to get to the bay. I am obviously from the bay, so my whole family is very excited to be able to see me and welcome me home.”
Since Warriors will organize the NBA All-Star weekend this year and Ionescu is from Walnut Creek, California, it is a surprise that something cannot be resolved to have them among the outstanding events in Chase Center this weekend.
